column7: BeginMFAEnrollment read MFAEnabled=false; a concurrent ActivateMFA committed; the late UpsertMFASecret (OnConflict{UpdateAll}) overwrote the ACTIVATED row with Activated=false and a fresh seed it returned to the enroller, and login verification did not read Activated, so that seed passed MFA on an MFA-enabled account. Fixed: UpsertMFASecret is a conditional upsert (ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE ... WHERE mfa_secrets.activated is false; 0 rows -> storage.ErrMFASecretActivated, nothing written) and BeginMFAEnrollment returns ErrMFAAlreadyEnabled. Two replicas on real Postgres, ActivateMFA forced between A's read and A's upsert; red on main (row replaced, A succeeded). Found by C-GUARD3-EXEMPT-REVIEW, reproduced by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1.
